rapport_notes: Warm, chatty, found real common ground (Glendale) that put the customer at ease throughout.

evidence_quotes.agenda: And then do you have any specific questions or concerns that you would like answered on this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said she just wanted 'a price and how long it's gonna take' -- no specific concern raised to follow up on.

top_strength: Built genuine personal rapport early (shared Glendale/Burbank connection) that carried warmth through the whole call and made the customer comfortable asking follow-up questions.
coaching_note: Never worked any of the five Save Your Ass lines into the pricing conversation (rate commitment, window framing, beats-it-pay-less, prep tip, fair-then-silence) before asking for the close -- add at least the window and prep-tip lines before the ask.
